page_title: LYO 2-3 REN | Lyon v Rennes 26/01/2024, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+6' There will be no more action in this match as the referee signals full time.
90+5' The goalkeeper pulls off a great save to deny Baptiste Santamaria (Rennes), whose good effort would probably have ended inside the right post.

90+4' Dejan Lovren (Lyon) evades the challenge and decides to shoot from distance, but it was a poor decision as the ball balloons high over the bar. The ball goes out of play and Rennes will have a goal kick.
90+4' Mama Balde (Lyon) attempts to find one of his teammates inside the box with a chip pass, but one of the defending players reacts superbly and intercepts the ball.
90+3' Lyon enjoy a period of possession as they are exchanging some passes and waiting for an opportunity to strike.
90' 5 additional min. will be played.
90' Referee Thomas Leonard has finally had enough of Julien Stephan and brandishes a yellow card at him!
89' Pierre Sage decides to make a substitution. Ainsley Maitland-Niles will be replaced by Mama Balde (Lyon).
86' Alexandre Lacazette (Lyon) commits a minor foul to interrupt the attacking move of his opponent and is warned by the referee that he will get a yellow card if he does it again.
85' The Lyon players are exchanging some short passes to try and open up the opposition’s defence and hit them swiftly on the break.
79' The referee signals that it is time for a substitution and Ludovic Blas (Rennes) is coming onto the pitch as Desire Doue cannot continue after picking up an injury.
79' Pierre Sage has decided to substitute Maxence Caqueret and he is replaced by Chaim El Djebali (Lyon).
79' The game has come to an end for Benjamin Bourigeaud. He has contributed as much as he could today. He will be replaced by the fresh legs of Ibrahim Salah (Rennes).
78' 2 - 3 Goal! Alexandre Lacazette (Lyon) pounced on a loose ball inside the penalty area and beats the goalkeeper with a shot into the bottom right corner. He makes it 2:3.
75' Jake O'Brien (Lyon) makes an overly-aggressive challenge and Thomas Leonard blows his whistle for a foul.
75' 10:9 – the total goal attempt statistics.
72' Rough tackle by Ernest Nuamah (Lyon). The referee blows his whistle for a foul.
71' Lyon enjoy a period of possession as they are exchanging some passes and waiting for an opportunity to strike.
69' Corentin Tolisso (Lyon) makes a strong challenge and Thomas Leonard blows for a foul.
67' Here is a change. Martin Terrier is going off and Julien Stephan gives the last tactical orders to Bertug Yildirim (Rennes).
66' Adrien Truffert (Rennes) goes into the book for a horrible tackle. A yellow card is necessary in this case.
66' Azor Matusiwa (Rennes) was too forceful with his tackle and Thomas Leonard interrupted the game to signal a free kick.
63' The referee allows time for a substitution. Arnaud Kalimuendo will be replaced by Azor Matusiwa (Rennes).
62' Lyon seem to be finding their feet as they enjoy some possession. They are waiting for the right moment to create new attacking opportunities.
61' Alexandre Lacazette (Lyon) gets in a good position inside the box and is only inches away from getting on the end of a through ball from the edge of the area.
58' The game is interrupted. Ernest Nuamah (Lyon) is given a yellow card. He has to be more careful now.
57' 1 - 3 Henrique (Lyon) receives the ball inside the box, reacts quickly and without any problems stabs the ball low inside the left post.
56' Clinton Mata (Lyon) trips an opposition player and Thomas Leonard signals a foul.
55' Some great controlled play and passing in the middle of the pitch from Rennes.
54' Lyon fail to score from a corner as Steve Mandanda (Rennes) leaps to collect the ball.
54' Maxence Caqueret (Lyon) has a shot blocked from inside the box.
52' It looks like Corentin Tolisso (Lyon) saw red with that tackle. Thomas Leonard won't tolerate such behaviour on the pitch and blows for a foul.
51' Gift Orban (Lyon) is unlucky with a low drive from the edge of the box. A decent save by Steve Mandanda stops the ball from hitting the middle of the net.
50' The Lyon players are exchanging some short passes.
49' Henrique (Lyon) hasn't suffered any serious injury which would see him leave the pitch. He's back in the game now.
48' Henrique (Lyon) requires medical treatment, so the referee stops play and signals for the physio to come onto the pitch.
46' There will be a change on the pitch for the second half. Pierre Sage probably wasn't satisfied with the performance of Malick Fofana (Lyon). He is replaced by Henrique.
46' The game is over for Mahamadou Diawara (Lyon). Gift Orban comes on for the second half.
46' Half-time substitution. Rayan Cherki (Lyon) is replaced by Ernest Nuamah.
46' The second half has just started.
45+4' The referee blows his whistle to end the first half and the players are now heading to their respective dressing rooms.
45+3' Rennes are bossing possession at the moment by exchanging some precise passes from player to player.
45+1' Benjamin Bourigeaud (Rennes) takes the corner kick and sends a lovely ball into the penalty area, but the opposition's defence is ready and knocks the ball to safety.
45' The fourth official shows 3 min. of added time.
44' Lyon can’t profit from the corner as the defence clear the ball upfield.
43' A corner kick by Lyon is thwarted by the well prepared Steve Mandanda (Rennes).
41' 0 - 3 Martin Terrier (Rennes) changes the scoreline after getting on the end of a brilliant pass and firing a precise shot that goes inside the right post!
41' Rennes have a corner.
40' Benjamin Bourigeaud (Rennes) tries his luck and takes a shot from inside the box. His effort on goal is blocked by a defender. The ball goes out of play. Rennes are awarded a corner kick.
39' Alexandre Lacazette (Lyon) tries to slide the ball through to a teammate but it's well blocked by a defender.

36' 0 - 2 Goal! That was a fantastic finish by Desire Doue (Rennes) from just outside the box. He wasted little time in getting away a bullet of a shot that flew past the goalkeeper into the left side of the net.
33' This yellow card was deserved. The tackle by Clinton Mata (Lyon) was quite harsh and Thomas Leonard didn't hesitate to show him a yellow card.
32' Enzo Le Fee (Rennes) feels very aggrieved after the referee stops play for a foul that he commits while heading towards goal with the ball.
29' Enzo Le Fee (Rennes) makes a rough challenge and Thomas Leonard blows his whistle for a foul.
29' Neat passing move from Lyon in order to create new attacking opportunities.

28' Martin Terrier (Rennes) has time and space to shoot after latching onto a pass, but his screamer of a shot flies just wide of the right post. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Lyon.
27' A cross is clipped into the penalty area by Baptiste Santamaria (Rennes) but poses no threat.
24' Corentin Tolisso (Lyon) plays in a hopeful cross, but it doesn't find its way to any of the attacking players. The ball goes out of play and Rennes will have a goal kick.
22' 0 - 1 After receiving a beautiful pass, Martin Terrier (Rennes) had a huge opportunity. He coolly unleashed a perfect shot, which went in off the left post.
20' Great teamplay by Rennes as they control the ball with a lot of short passes. Patience is the key if they want to find a gap in the defence to score.
18' Maxence Caqueret (Lyon) hits a first-time shot from the edge of the box low towards the middle of the goal, but Steve Mandanda is equal to the task and makes a comfortable save.

17' Ainsley Maitland-Niles (Lyon) is obviously not following the Golden Rule: "Treat others as you want to be treated.“ He makes a bad challenge and leaves Thomas Leonard with no other option than to blow for a foul.
17' Thomas Leonard has a clear sight and sees a foul from Enzo Le Fee (Rennes).
17' Martin Terrier (Rennes) nearly creates a chance, but his attempt to pick out a teammate with a through ball does not come off.
14' Alexandre Lacazette (Lyon) attempted to pick out a free teammate inside the box, but Steve Mandanda comes off the line to clear the ball away.
11' The Rennes players keep the ball and are exchanging a combination of passes. They are waiting for gaps in the defence to open up.
10' Dejan Lovren (Lyon) gives away a foul for a clumsy challenge. Referee Thomas Leonard saw the whole situation.
9' Maxence Caqueret (Lyon) drills a powerful shot from long range towards the middle of the goal, but Steve Mandanda makes a comfortable save.
7' Baptiste Santamaria (Rennes) makes a bad challenge and receives a yellow card. The referee had no doubt.
3' Desire Doue (Rennes) was trying to get to the ball but clattered into the legs of the opponent as well. Thomas Leonard blows his whistle for an infringement.
2' Rennes control the tempo of the game by exchanging some accurate short passes.
1' Baptiste Santamaria (Rennes) makes a rough challenge and the referee blows for a foul.
1' Today's match has just started, enjoy the game!
Rennes will kick-off.
Today's referee will be Thomas Leonard.
